definitions.gloss: radio calisthenics; NHK morning exercise routine
definitions.explanation: A set routine of light exercises done to piano music broadcast on NHK radio every morning. First aired in 1928, it is practiced in schools, workplaces, and neighborhood parks, and most Japanese people know the moves by heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧ラジオ{体操|たいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I do radio calisthenics every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧ラジオ{体操|たいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}った→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: During summer vacation I went to radio calisthenics every morning.

examples.english: At the factory, everyone does radio calisthenics together before work starts.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ラジオ{体操|たいそう}⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧: Radio Calisthenics No. 1, the best-known routine
- ラジオ{体操|たいそう}{第二|だいに}: Radio Calisthenics No. 2, a slightly more vigorous routine
- ラジオ{体操|たいそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧: the attendance card children get stamped

CULTURAL NOTE:
During summer vacation, neighborhood groups gather in parks early in the morning, and children get a stamp on a card for each day they attend. Many factories and building sites also start the working day with the routine.
